subject.title: Add auth sync command or auto-sync for API key rotation across agents

question: Should OpenClaw solve API-key rotation shadowing with an explicit operator-controlled bulk auth repair/warning path, automatic sync on config writes, or runtime fallback after auth failure?
rationale: All viable fixes change credential precedence or secret propagation across agent stores, and repository policy treats auth/config/session state as compatibility- and security-sensitive.

options.title: Operator-controlled repair and warning
options.body: Add a doctor/status or `models auth` repair path that detects shadowed rotated keys and updates canonical SQLite auth stores only after an explicit user action.

options.title: Automatic sync on config write
options.body: Update affected agent auth stores when config env/provider keys change, trading convenience for higher risk of silent secret propagation.

options.title: Runtime fallback on 401
options.body: Try env/config credentials after a stored-profile failure, trading recovery convenience for a more complex and potentially surprising auth precedence model.

recommendation.title: Operator-controlled repair and warning
recommendation.body: Add a doctor/status or `models auth` repair path that detects shadowed rotated keys and updates canonical SQLite auth stores only after an explicit user action.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant history for auth storage, CLI surface, and runtime auth precedence points to steipete as the strongest routing owner.
